objective: Preserve small-account survival while converging toward or beating R9 SYNTH January on trade count, net profit, gross loss and true max drawdown.

promoted_supermodel_core.reason: Best combined net/gross-loss/survivability parent among completed exact stack tests; complementary residual failure ownership specialists.

R10AA.rule: Residual HOLD/CONT/180s at +30s: if primary PnL > +$0.06 and MFE <= +$2.07, close current basket/cancel future legs; shadow slot remains frozen to original episode end.

R10AB.rule: Residual HOLD/REVERT/900s at +90s: if primary PnL > +$0.24, path efficiency > 0.03, MAE <= -$0.48, close basket/cancel future legs and reverse one 0.01 for 30s; shadow slot frozen.

R10AG_SEQ45_60.description: Sequential REVERT/900 failure-owner supermodel using two causal decision stages rather than a single rule.

R10AH.rule: Residual HOLD/REVERT/600 at +30s: if observed tick intensity > 4.2 ticks/s, close basket/cancel future legs and reverse one 0.01 for 180s; shadow slot frozen.

R10AI.decision: Do not enable unconditionally from $100. Test physical activation at $150/$175/$200/$250/$300 while keeping virtual state warm.

R10AP.decision: Capital-gated velocity desk candidate after core loss/DD stabilization; do not attach physically at $100 yet.

R10AR.decision: Second capital-gated velocity desk; subordinate to AP until core is stable.

important_nonpromotions.R10AC: Higher net than R10AB but worsens physical gross loss and DD; do not stack for current objective.
important_nonpromotions.R10AF: Useful predecessor/alternative REVERT900 refinement, but R10AG is cleaner for the current supermodel.
important_nonpromotions.additional_pulse_depth: Do not add rescue depth simply to increase complexity; later rescue-depth research previously hit diminishing returns.

immediate_next_units: R10AI capital gate sweep: $150/$175/$200/$250/$300; preserve AG+AH near-$100 equity floor while recovering most AI economics.
Exact DD forensic on the ~+$203 tick-DD episode in AG+AH; build a specialist only against that causal path, not a global tightening rule.
After loss/DD stabilization, exact capital-gated integration of R10AP; then R10AR only if incremental net/velocity survives the same safety gates.
human_soft_target: Prefer new specialists with >50% causal success where economically meaningful, but promotion is based on net + gross loss + DD + velocity + survival jointly, not hit rate alone.
